search_semantics: NAME substring only; descriptions are not searched
case-insensitive: TIMESHEET, Timesheet and timesheet all return 1 result
matches across the slash: search=theluckystrike/time returns io.github.theluckystrike/time-tracker
any two-word query with a space returns 0 for every server in the registry
results are sorted alphabetically by the FULL name, so io.github.theluckystrike/* always sits near the bottom regardless of the slug
every server appears once per published version (0.1.0 and 0.1.1 are two rows)
index lag after publish is 1-3 minutes: csv and pdf missed our new names on the first re-probe and matched on the second
visibility_model: p(seen | query) = 0 if we do not appear, else min(1, 10/rank). Server organic = 100 x mean(p) over that server's natural query set (listed in data/organic.json servers[].query_set). Applied identically to before and after.

variants_r2_2026-09-03.note: Task 3 round 2. Bounded single-page probe (GET .../v0/servers?search=<token>&limit=100, one request per token, 25s timeout with 3 retries; '100+' means the page was full and a nextCursor existed, i.e. true total is higher but irrelevant for near-empty-token selection since those are always under 100 and captured on one page). 47 tokens probed pre-publish. 7 variants published (2026-09-03) as new registry entries pointing at the same v0.4.2 mcpb package/sha as the parent server; remotes[] was DROPPED from every variant because the registry rejects a second server row reusing the same remote URL (400: 'remote URL ... is already used by server ...') -- so variants are stdio-only (mcpb) while the parent names keep their hosted remotes[]. Post-publish re-probe could not complete: registry.modelcontextprotocol.io/v0/servers started timing out on every request (10-25s, all retries) during the re-measurement window, a live API outage/degradation distinct from the previously-documented 1-3 minute index lag. Numbers below are therefore the PRE-publish baseline only; the after-side of data/organic.json carries the variant names as newly-held-by-definition (the registry row now exists under that exact name) but keeps pre-publish rank/result-count figures with a flag that live re-verification is pending.
